Evolution is a game mechanic in Vampire Survivors that typically transforms a base weapon into a stronger evolved weapon using a passive item as a catalyst. Additionally, there are a few unique categories of evolution that some weapons follow.

A Union is a combination of two or more weapons. Union weapons share similar characteristics with evolved weapons, except the requisite weapons are merged into one weapon slot after the Union weapon is obtained.

A Gift is an additional weapon or passive item a player receives when evolution conditions are met, and does not change any required weapons or items. Gifts act as an additional weapon or passive item, without replacing the base weapon.

A Morph involves a permanent transformation for a specific character, attainable by reaching a high enough level and acquiring certain relics as catalysts. Morphs on this page are specific to weapons that can evolve through morphing specific characters, such as Bone morphing into Anima of Mortaccio alongside Moraccio.
Evolved weapons usually inherit most of the base weapon stats with extra effects. Most Area-of-Effect weapons may add bonus to
and some have changes on base damage because their behavior is different.

The player must have a fully leveled base weapon and its counterpart (required level varies by case) in their inventory.

can evolve weapons with any chest pickup that gives an item, regardless of other conditions.

The chest will then grant an evolved weapon as its first reward in place of the usual random upgrade if and only if the evolved weapon is not banished. On evolution, the base weapon is typically removed and the evolved weapon is added, while the passive item remains unaffected. On union, all requisite base weapons are removed and their union is added, reducing the number of occupied weapon slots. Upon obtaining a Gift, the base weapon will not be replaced when the Gift is obtained.
Generally, only one weapon can be evolved per chest, including the higher tier chests. However, some chests contain multiple evolutions.

Chests in Il Molise, Bat Country, and Tiny Bridge, and the chest from Giant Enemy Crab can evolve up to five weapons. The rest can evolve up to three. To evolve multiple weapons at once, these chests must be of the higher tier with enough rewards, as evolution is a type of reward.

When playing in Co-op, weapons are capable of evolution regardless of which player has the Passive Weapon and which player has the Active Weapon, so long as the requirements are met and the share passives option in the level select menu is enabled.
Certain weapons evolve automatically when a character morphs into a new form, which occurs once the player has met the required conditions and, for base game characters, obtained the necessary relic.

When a base game character morphs, their starting weapon evolves into a new weapon as well, and picking up a chest is not required. However, for DLC characters, morphing does not evolve their starting weapon.
